subject: Mongols Bikie Arrest in Darwin
posts: Justice moves slowly, but it eventually catches up to those who think they can outrun the law. Mongols Bikie Arrest in Darwin. Evidence: public safety, fugitive apprehension, rule of law. #Aletheia #LawAndOrder

Northern Territory Police apprehended Brandt Graham, a Mongols bikie who had been on the run for five days after escaping a court dock. The arrest was captured on body-worn cameras.
